t: The Manrose XF100S 100mm (4") axial bathroom extractor fan is a reliable ventilation solution for domestic properties. This wall-mounted unit is ideal for maintaining air quality in bathrooms, particularly within Zone 2, by efficiently removing moisture and odours. It features an 85 m³/hr extraction rate and operates on a 240V mains supply with a single speed. Constructed from durable white plastic, the fan is double-insulated and includes overload protection for enhanced safety. With an IP24 rating and fixings supplied, installation is straightforward, ensuring compliance with Building Regulation Parts F and L when fitted correctly.
